cohort: The study included all women with diabetes mellitus who delivered in a tertiary care hospital in Dubai between January 1, 2017, and December 31, 2019.
finding: Achieving HbA1c levels <6.5% by the third trimester in women with diabetes mellitus resulted in a prevalence of macrosomia (8%) similar to the general population, although preterm delivery was significantly higher in T1DM versus T2DM (50% vs. 27%).
mod_finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 62%, with 50% of these due to repeat elective cesarean section.
